articles.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

articles.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
articles.snippet: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

articles.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
articles.snippet: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

articles.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
articles.snippet: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

articles.title: Vibecoded GTA 6 PC Ports Are Now Rendering In-Game Graphics Despite Take-Two Crackdown
articles.snippet: Some unofficial ports now hit around 20 frames per second, as developers move their work into private communities to dodge takedowns.
